answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit jobs, and slash that stake when independent audits show fabricated identities coordinating to claim rewards. Audits can compare behavior across tasks and trigger a challenge in which the agent must complete a costly, unpredictable task; passing returns the stake, while failing burns it. A saffron seller, a pearl broker, and a summit planner can still participate, but an attacker must lock real capital per identity and risks losing it, making mass Sybils expensive rather than merely easy to create.
